description.value: Thai Away Home is a multi-location Thai restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver serving dine-in, take-out, and delivery meals rooted in authentic Thai recipes with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The menu caters broadly to diverse dietary needs, including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options across curries, noodle dishes, salads, and fried chicken. Cambie Street is a recognized cycling corridor in Vancouver, making this a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the city.
